# Built-in comparison components

## Levels

Entry-point group: `qavf.compare.levels`.

### `contribution`

Members' contributions to the total change, minimal sets and mix versus rate.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision` | `Literal['material', 'significant', 'material_and_significant', 'equivalence'] \| None` | `None` | ``material_and_significant`` (default), ``material``, ``significant`` or ``equivalence``. |
| `alpha` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `correction` | `Literal['none', 'bonferroni', 'holm', 'bh', 'by'] \| None` | `None` | Multiple-testing correction across each check's family of tests. |
| `seed` | `int \| None` | `None` |  |
| `max_work` | `int \| None` | `None` |  |
| `measure` | `MeasureSpec` | `{'measure': 'count', 'column': None, 'name': None, 'comparators': ['diff', 'rel_diff'], 'rtol': None, 'atol': None, 'exact': False, 'test': None, 'params': {}}` | An additive measure: ``count``, ``sum(x)`` or ``null_count(x)``. |
| `dimensions` | `tuple[Dimension, ...]` | `[]` | Dimensions to explain the total change along (``zone``, ``[zone, fc]``, ...). |
| `share` | `float` | `0.8` | Share of the total change the minimal set of members must explain. |
| `rates` | `tuple[RateCheck, ...]` | `[]` | Rates decomposed into mix and rate effects, ``"fatal / vmt"`` or a mapping. |
| `rtol` | `float \| None` | `None` | Default relative tolerance of this level; the comparison's when omitted. |
| `atol` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |

#### `MeasureSpec`

A measure and how its change is judged: ``sum(x)``-style or a mapping.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `measure` | `str` | **required** |  |
| `column` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |
| `name` | `str \| None` | `None` | Label in reports; ``measure(column)`` when omitted. |
| `comparators` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `('diff', 'rel_diff')` |  |
| `rtol` | `float \| None` | `None` | Relative tolerance; the column's, then the level's, then the comparison's. |
| `atol` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `exact` | `bool` | `False` |  |
| `test` | `TestConfig \| None` | `None` | Significance test of the change per group; the measure's default when omitted (``mean``: ``welch_t``, ``median``: ``mann_whitney``, ``count``: ``poisson``, ...), ``none``: judged by materiality alone. |
| `params` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` |  |

#### `TestConfig`

A significance test: ``welch_t``, ``{test: bootstrap, resamples: 999}`` or ``none``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test` | `str` | **required** | A registered test (``qavf.inference.TESTS``), or ``none``: no test applies. |
| `params` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` |  |

#### `Dimension`

What members the total splits into: ``zone``, ``[zone, fc]`` or with ``time``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `[]` |  |
| `time` | `TimeMembers \| None` | `None` | Also split by time bucket: ``{time_column: day, bucket: month}`` (zone x month). |
| `name` | `str \| None` | `None` | Label in reports; the columns (and bucket) joined by `` x `` when omitted. |

#### `TimeMembers`

Time buckets as members of a level: ``{time_column: day, bucket: month}``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bucket` | `Bucket \| None` | `None` | Calendar bucket or cyclic profile of a Date/Datetime time column (``day``, ``15 minutes``, ``month``, ``hour_of_day``, ...). Without it, time values are used as they are (a numeric period such as a year). |
| `time_zone` | `str \| None` | `None` | IANA zone of the local calendar: naive times are wall-clock times there, aware times are converted to it. Aware columns default to their own zone. |
| `time_format` | `str \| None` | `None` | ``strftime`` format for parsing a text time column (unparseable values are reported, never dropped). |
| `time_column` | `str` | **required** | Date, Datetime, text (with ``time_format``) or numeric period column. |
| `max_buckets` | `int` | `1000000` |  |

#### `Bucket`

A calendar bucket (``day``, ``15 minutes``, ``6h``) or a cyclic profile (``season``).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unit` | `Literal['second', 'minute', 'hour', 'day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter', 'year', 'hour_of_day', 'day_of_week', 'day_of_year', 'month_of_year', 'quarter_of_year', 'season']` | **required** | ``second``, ``minute``, ``hour``, ``day``, ``week``, ``month``, ``quarter``, ``year``, or a profile: ``hour_of_day``, ``day_of_week``, ``day_of_year``, ``month_of_year``, ``quarter_of_year``, ``season``. |
| `every` | `int` | `1` | Multiple of a calendar unit (``{unit: minute, every: 15}``). |
| `week_start` | `Literal['monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday', 'sunday']` | `monday` | First day of a ``week`` bucket, and of the ``day_of_week`` order. |
| `hemisphere` | `Literal['north', 'south']` | `north` | Names of the meteorological seasons (December-February is winter in the north). |
| `seasons` | `dict[str, tuple[int, ...]] \| None` | `None` | Custom seasons, ``name: [months]`` in cycle order, covering each month once. |

#### `RateCheck`

An overall rate ``sum(numerator) / sum(denominator)`` decomposed over a dimension.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `numerator` | `str` | **required** |  |
| `denominator` | `str` | **required** |  |
| `name` | `str \| None` | `None` | Label in reports; ``numerator / denominator`` when omitted. |
| `dimension` | `str \| None` | `None` | The dimension label whose members are the strata; the first dimension by default. |
| `method` | `Literal['three_term', 'symmetric']` | `three_term` | ``three_term``: mix, rate and interaction (shift-share); ``symmetric``: Kitagawa's two terms, each difference weighted by the mean of the other factor. |
| `rtol` | `float \| None` | `None` | Relative tolerance of the overall rate; the level's, then the comparison's. |
| `atol` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `test` | `Literal['poisson', 'none'] \| None` | `None` | Poisson test of the overall rate (whole-number numerators, the default for them), or ``none``: judged by materiality. |

### `coverage`

Keys only in the baseline or only in the candidate, and null-rate changes.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allow_added` | `bool` | `False` | Keys only in the candidate are acceptable (e.g. new sites). |
| `allow_removed` | `bool` | `False` | Keys only in the baseline are acceptable. |
| `group_by` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `[]` | Break one-sided keys down by these columns (read from the side holding the key). |
| `max_null_rate_change` | `float` | `0.0` | Largest acceptable change of a column's missing fraction (0.01 = one point). |

### `distribution`

Distribution distances, quantile deltas and category changes per column and member.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision` | `Literal['material', 'significant', 'material_and_significant', 'equivalence'] \| None` | `None` | ``material_and_significant`` (default), ``material``, ``significant`` or ``equivalence``. |
| `alpha` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `correction` | `Literal['none', 'bonferroni', 'holm', 'bh', 'by'] \| None` | `None` | Multiple-testing correction across each check's family of tests. |
| `seed` | `int \| None` | `None` |  |
| `max_work` | `int \| None` | `None` |  |
| `columns` | `tuple[DistributionColumn, ...]` | **required** | Columns whose distributions are compared. |
| `group_by` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `[]` | Compare within each group (a zone column too); the whole side when empty. |
| `time` | `TimeMembers \| None` | `None` | Also compare per time bucket: ``{time_column: day, bucket: month}``. |
| `bins` | `int` | `10` | Quantile bins of the baseline for PSI and Jensen-Shannon (numeric); a baseline with no more distinct values than this uses one bin per value. |
| `thresholds` | `Thresholds` | `{'max_psi': 0.2, 'max_ks': 0.1, 'max_wasserstein': None, 'max_js': 0.05}` |  |
| `quantiles` | `QuantileCheck \| None` | `{'probabilities': [0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9], 'rtol': None, 'atol': None}` | Quantile deltas; ``null`` leaves them out. |
| `test` | `Literal['ks', 'anderson_darling']` | `ks` | Significance test of a numeric distribution change. |
| `categorical_test` | `Literal['chi_square', 'g_test']` | `chi_square` | Significance test of a categorical distribution change (homogeneity). |
| `min_values` | `int` | `2` | Fewest values on each side for a member to be measured. |
| `missing_groups` | `Literal['fail', 'ignore']` | `fail` | A member (group, bucket) present on one side only: a difference or left out. |
| `new_categories` | `Literal['fail', 'ignore']` | `fail` | Categories that appeared or disappeared: a difference, or reported only. |
| `rtol` | `float \| None` | `None` | Default relative tolerance of the quantile deltas; the comparison's when omitted. |
| `atol` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |

#### `Thresholds`

When a distribution change is material (``null`` leaves a metric out).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_psi` | `float \| None` | `0.2` | Population stability index (0.1 small, 0.2 notable, 0.25 large). |
| `max_ks` | `float \| None` | `0.1` | Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance, the largest gap of the CDFs (numeric). |
| `max_wasserstein` | `float \| None` | `None` | Earth mover's distance in the column's units (numeric; off by default). |
| `max_js` | `float \| None` | `0.05` | Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits on the shared bins or categories. |

#### `QuantileCheck`

Quantile-by-quantile deltas, material beyond ``max(atol, rtol * max(\|b\|, \|c\|))``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `probabilities` | `tuple[float, ...]` | `(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)` |  |
| `rtol` | `float \| None` | `None` | Relative tolerance; the column's, then the level's, then the comparison's. |
| `atol` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |

### `locations`

Distance moved per keyed feature; area and shape changes of geometries.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | `str \| None` | `None` | Longitude or easting column. |
| `y` | `str \| None` | `None` | Latitude or northing column. |
| `geometry` | `str \| None` | `None` | A WKB geometry column instead of ``x``/``y`` (points, lines or polygons). |
| `crs` | `str` | `EPSG:4326` | CRS of both sides' locations. |
| `max_distance` | `float` | `0.0` | Largest move (point, or centroid) that is no change: metres for a geographic CRS. |
| `area` | `AreaCheck \| None` | `{'rtol': 0.0, 'atol': 0.0}` | Area changes of geometries; ``null`` leaves the check out. |
| `shape` | `ShapeCheck \| None` | `{'max_difference': 0.0}` | Shape changes of geometries; ``null`` leaves the check out. |

#### `AreaCheck`

A geometry's area may change within ``max(atol, rtol * max(\|a\|, \|b\|))``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rtol` | `float` | `0.0` | Relative tolerance of the areas. |
| `atol` | `float` | `0.0` | Absolute tolerance: square metres for a geographic CRS, else square CRS units. |

#### `ShapeCheck`

Geometries are equal, or differ by at most ``max_difference`` of area.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_difference` | `float` | `0.0` | Largest symmetric-difference area (the units of ``area``). |

#### `CorrelationCheck`

Correlations of every pair of ``columns`` should not change by ``max_change``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `tuple[str, ...]` | **required** | Numeric columns; every pair is compared. |
| `methods` | `tuple[Literal['pearson', 'spearman'], ...]` | `('pearson', 'spearman')` |  |
| `max_change` | `float` | `0.1` | Largest acceptable change of a correlation coefficient. |
| `min_pairs` | `int` | `4` | Fewest complete rows on each side for a correlation to be measured. |

#### `RatioCheck`

A ratio invariant ``sum(numerator) / sum(denominator)``: ``fatal / crashes``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `numerator` | `str` | **required** |  |
| `denominator` | `str` | **required** |  |
| `name` | `str \| None` | `None` | Label in reports; ``numerator / denominator`` when omitted. |
| `rtol` | `float \| None` | `None` | Relative tolerance of the ratio; the level's, then the comparison's. |
| `atol` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `test` | `Literal['poisson', 'none'] \| None` | `None` | ``poisson``: two event rates per exposure (whole-number numerators); ``none``: judged by materiality alone. By default Poisson for integer numerators. |

#### `AgreementCheck`

Matched values agree: thresholds per metric (``null`` leaves one out).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `tuple[str, ...]` | **required** | Numeric columns compared record by record. |
| `fit` | `Literal['ols', 'deming']` | `ols` | The candidate-on-baseline line: ``ols`` (the baseline as exact) or ``deming`` (both sides measured with error, in ``error_ratio``). |
| `error_ratio` | `float` | `1.0` | Deming: the candidate's error variance over the baseline's. |
| `min_pairs` | `int` | `3` | Fewest matched pairs for a member to be measured. |
| `max_abs_bias` | `float \| None` | `None` | Largest ``\|mean(candidate - baseline)\|``, in data units. |
| `max_loa` | `float \| None` | `None` | Largest ``\|limit of agreement\|`` (bias -/+ 1.96 sd), in data units. |
| `min_ccc` | `float \| None` | `0.99` | Lowest Lin's concordance correlation. |
| `max_mae` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `max_rmse` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `max_mape` | `float \| None` | `None` | Largest mean absolute percentage difference (percent). |
| `max_smape` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `min_r_squared` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `max_slope_deviation` | `float \| None` | `0.05` | Largest ``\|slope - 1\|`` of the fitted line. |
| `max_abs_intercept` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |

### `series_shape`

Correlation, trend, profile, peak, lag and level-shift differences per series.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision` | `Literal['material', 'significant', 'material_and_significant', 'equivalence'] \| None` | `None` | ``material_and_significant`` (default), ``material``, ``significant`` or ``equivalence``. |
| `alpha` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `correction` | `Literal['none', 'bonferroni', 'holm', 'bh', 'by'] \| None` | `None` | Multiple-testing correction across each check's family of tests. |
| `seed` | `int \| None` | `None` |  |
| `max_work` | `int \| None` | `None` |  |
| `time_column` | `str` | **required** | Date, Datetime, text (with ``time_format``) or numeric period column. |
| `group_by` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `[]` | One series per combination of these columns. |
| `bucket` | `Bucket \| None` | `None` | Calendar bucket or cyclic profile of a Date/Datetime time column (``day``, ``15 minutes``, ``month``, ``hour_of_day``, ...). Without it, time values are used as they are (a numeric period such as a year). |
| `time_zone` | `str \| None` | `None` | IANA zone of the local calendar: naive times are wall-clock times there, aware times are converted to it. Aware columns default to their own zone. |
| `time_format` | `str \| None` | `None` | ``strftime`` format for parsing a text time column (unparseable values are reported, never dropped). |
| `max_buckets` | `int` | `1000000` | Largest expected bucket grid; a longer one is not assessed. |
| `measure` | `MeasureSpec` | `{'measure': 'count', 'column': None, 'name': None, 'comparators': ['diff', 'rel_diff'], 'rtol': None, 'atol': None, 'exact': False, 'test': None, 'params': {}}` | The series value per bucket (``sum(x)``, ``mean(x)``, ...; rows by default). |
| `min_buckets` | `int` | `4` | Fewest buckets both sides must have for a series to be assessed. |
| `missing_series` | `Literal['fail', 'ignore']` | `fail` | A series (group) on one side only: a difference or left out. |
| `correlation` | `CorrelationCheck \| None` | `{'min_pearson': 0.9, 'min_spearman': 0.9, 'dependence': 'effective_n'}` | Pearson and Spearman correlation; ``null`` leaves the check out (so for each). |
| `trend` | `TrendCheck \| None` | `{'rtol': 0.1, 'atol': 0.0, 'dependence': 'block'}` | Least-squares slope per bucket on each side. |
| `profile` | `ProfileCheck \| None` | `None` | Cyclic profile of the buckets (off unless configured). |
| `peak` | `PeakCheck \| None` | `{'max_shift': 0, 'rtol': 0.1, 'atol': 0.0}` | Peak timing and magnitude. |
| `lag` | `LagCheck \| None` | `{'max_lag': 3, 'allowed': 0}` | Best cross-correlation lag. |
| `level_shift` | `LevelShiftCheck \| None` | `{'min_segment': 4, 'threshold': 5.0, 'min_relative_shift': 0.2, 'max_offset': 0}` | Level shifts present in only one version. |

#### `Bucket`

A calendar bucket (``day``, ``15 minutes``, ``6h``) or a cyclic profile (``season``).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unit` | `Literal['second', 'minute', 'hour', 'day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter', 'year', 'hour_of_day', 'day_of_week', 'day_of_year', 'month_of_year', 'quarter_of_year', 'season']` | **required** | ``second``, ``minute``, ``hour``, ``day``, ``week``, ``month``, ``quarter``, ``year``, or a profile: ``hour_of_day``, ``day_of_week``, ``day_of_year``, ``month_of_year``, ``quarter_of_year``, ``season``. |
| `every` | `int` | `1` | Multiple of a calendar unit (``{unit: minute, every: 15}``). |
| `week_start` | `Literal['monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday', 'sunday']` | `monday` | First day of a ``week`` bucket, and of the ``day_of_week`` order. |
| `hemisphere` | `Literal['north', 'south']` | `north` | Names of the meteorological seasons (December-February is winter in the north). |
| `seasons` | `dict[str, tuple[int, ...]] \| None` | `None` | Custom seasons, ``name: [months]`` in cycle order, covering each month once. |

#### `MeasureSpec`

A measure and how its change is judged: ``sum(x)``-style or a mapping.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `measure` | `str` | **required** |  |
| `column` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |
| `name` | `str \| None` | `None` | Label in reports; ``measure(column)`` when omitted. |
| `comparators` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `('diff', 'rel_diff')` |  |
| `rtol` | `float \| None` | `None` | Relative tolerance; the column's, then the level's, then the comparison's. |
| `atol` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `exact` | `bool` | `False` |  |
| `test` | `TestConfig \| None` | `None` | Significance test of the change per group; the measure's default when omitted (``mean``: ``welch_t``, ``median``: ``mann_whitney``, ``count``: ``poisson``, ...), ``none``: judged by materiality alone. |
| `params` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` |  |

#### `TestConfig`

A significance test: ``welch_t``, ``{test: bootstrap, resamples: 999}`` or ``none``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test` | `str` | **required** | A registered test (``qavf.inference.TESTS``), or ``none``: no test applies. |
| `params` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` |  |

#### `CorrelationCheck`

Both correlations must reach their minimum (``null`` skips one).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_pearson` | `float \| None` | `0.9` | Lowest Pearson correlation of the paired bucket values. |
| `min_spearman` | `float \| None` | `0.9` | Lowest Spearman (rank) correlation. |
| `dependence` | `Literal['effective_n', 'none']` | `effective_n` | Sample size of the Fisher z test: Bartlett's effective size for autocorrelated buckets, or the bucket count. |

#### `TrendCheck`

The slopes differ materially beyond ``max(atol, rtol * max(\|b\|, \|c\|))``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rtol` | `float` | `0.1` | Relative tolerance of the least-squares slopes (change per bucket). |
| `atol` | `float` | `0.0` |  |
| `dependence` | `Literal['block', 'hac', 'none']` | `block` | Uncertainty of the slope difference: a null-imposed circular block bootstrap, Newey-West HAC errors, or independent residuals. |

#### `ProfileCheck`

Cyclic profiles (mean per position, normalized) may differ by ``max_distance``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | `Bucket` | **required** | A cyclic profile of the buckets: ``hour_of_day``, ``day_of_week``, ``month_of_year``... |
| `max_distance` | `float` | `0.05` | Largest half-sum of absolute share differences (0: identical, 1: disjoint). |

#### `PeakCheck`

The peaks fall within ``max_shift`` buckets and agree in magnitude.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_shift` | `int` | `0` | Buckets the candidate's peak may move (around the cycle for profiles). |
| `rtol` | `float` | `0.1` | Relative tolerance of the peak values. |
| `atol` | `float` | `0.0` |  |

#### `LagCheck`

The best-correlated lag within ``max_lag`` buckets is at most ``allowed``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_lag` | `int` | `3` | Lags searched in each direction (cross-correlation of the two series). |
| `allowed` | `int` | `0` | Largest acceptable best lag. |

#### `LevelShiftCheck`

Level shifts (TMP-008's screen) appear on both sides, at most ``max_offset`` apart.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_segment` | `int` | `4` | Fewest buckets on each side of a candidate shift. |
| `threshold` | `float` | `5.0` | Gap in medians, in pooled robust spreads, that makes a shift. |
| `min_relative_shift` | `float` | `0.2` | Also require the medians to differ by this fraction of the earlier one. |
| `max_offset` | `int` | `0` | Buckets between the two sides' shifts still counted as the same shift. |

### `spatial`

Measures per zone, zones on one side or missing, rank, share and cluster changes.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision` | `Literal['material', 'significant', 'material_and_significant', 'equivalence'] \| None` | `None` | ``material_and_significant`` (default), ``material``, ``significant`` or ``equivalence``. |
| `alpha` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `correction` | `Literal['none', 'bonferroni', 'holm', 'bh', 'by'] \| None` | `None` | Multiple-testing correction across each check's family of tests. |
| `seed` | `int \| None` | `None` |  |
| `max_work` | `int \| None` | `None` |  |
| `zone_column` | `str` | `zone` | The zone id column (an attribute, or the ``assign_zones`` step's ``column``). |
| `measures` | `tuple[MeasureSpec, ...]` | `(MeasureSpec(measure='count', column=None, name=None, comparators=('diff', 'rel_diff'), rtol=None, atol=None, exact=False, test=None, params={}),)` | Measures compared per zone (``count``, ``sum(x)``, ...). |
| `missing_zones` | `Literal['fail', 'ignore']` | `fail` | A zone present on one side only: a difference or left out. |
| `expected` | `bool \| None` | `None` | Report expected zones (the layer's, or the grid extent's cells) a side lacks: whenever zones are known by default, ``true`` to require it, ``false`` to skip. |
| `allow_missing` | `bool` | `False` | Report missing expected zones without failing. |
| `layer` | `ZoneLayer \| None` | `None` | The zones, when not from an ``assign_zones`` step. |
| `grid` | `Grid \| None` | `None` | Grid cells as zones, when not from an ``assign_zones`` step. |
| `weights` | `WeightsSpec` | `{'method': 'queen', 'k': 4, 'distance': None, 'row_standardize': True, 'table': None}` | Neighbours of the ``moran`` and ``lisa`` checks. |
| `pattern_measure` | `str \| None` | `None` | The measure label the pattern checks read; the first measure by default. |
| `difference` | `str` | `diff` | Comparator turning a zone's two values into the difference ``moran`` and ``lisa`` read (``diff``, ``rel_diff``, ``log_ratio``, ...). |
| `permutations` | `int` | `999` | Permutations of the Moran and LISA tests. |
| `rank` | `RankCheck \| None` | `None` | Spearman correlation of the zones, when their ordering matters (``rank: {}``). Opt-in: where zones have similar values, immaterial noise reorders them, so a rank check would fail although nothing material changed. Other checks are on by default; ``null`` leaves one out. |
| `shares` | `ShareCheck \| None` | `{'max_change': 0.01}` | Zones that gained or lost share of their side's total. |
| `moran` | `MoranCheck \| None` | `{'min_i': 0.1}` | Global Moran's I of the per-zone differences. |
| `lisa` | `LisaCheck \| None` | `{}` | Local Moran's I: the zones in significant clusters of material change. |
| `rtol` | `float \| None` | `None` | Default relative tolerance of this level; the comparison's when omitted. |
| `atol` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `map` | `bool` | `True` | Keep simplified zone outlines for the report's map (from the layer or grid). |
| `map_vertices` | `int` | `20000` | Most outline vertices kept after simplification; a larger map is left out. |

#### `MeasureSpec`

A measure and how its change is judged: ``sum(x)``-style or a mapping.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `measure` | `str` | **required** |  |
| `column` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |
| `name` | `str \| None` | `None` | Label in reports; ``measure(column)`` when omitted. |
| `comparators` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `('diff', 'rel_diff')` |  |
| `rtol` | `float \| None` | `None` | Relative tolerance; the column's, then the level's, then the comparison's. |
| `atol` | `float \| None` | `None` |  |
| `exact` | `bool` | `False` |  |
| `test` | `TestConfig \| None` | `None` | Significance test of the change per group; the measure's default when omitted (``mean``: ``welch_t``, ``median``: ``mann_whitney``, ``count``: ``poisson``, ...), ``none``: judged by materiality alone. |
| `params` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` |  |

#### `TestConfig`

A significance test: ``welch_t``, ``{test: bootstrap, resamples: 999}`` or ``none``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test` | `str` | **required** | A registered test (``qavf.inference.TESTS``), or ``none``: no test applies. |
| `params` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` |  |

#### `ZoneLayer`

Zone polygons: ``{dataset: name}`` or ``{path: file}``, with an ``id`` column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | `str \| None` | `None` | A configured dataset holding the zones (an id and a WKB or WKT geometry column). |
| `path` | `str \| None` | `None` | A local GeoParquet, GeoJSON, shapefile or other ``ST_Read`` file (relative to the configuration). |
| `id` | `str` | `zone` | Zone id column. |
| `geometry` | `str \| None` | `None` | Geometry column: ``geometry`` for datasets and GeoParquet, ``geom`` for ``ST_Read``. |
| `crs` | `str` | `EPSG:4326` | CRS of the polygons; a file declaring another one is refused. |
| `layer` | `str \| None` | `None` | Layer of a multi-layer file (``ST_Read``'s ``layer``). |
| `repair` | `bool` | `False` | Replace invalid geometries with ``ST_MakeValid`` (recorded) instead of refusing them. |

#### `Grid`

Square cells of ``size`` CRS units from ``origin``, optionally over an ``extent``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `float` | **required** | Cell width in CRS units (metres for a projected CRS, degrees for a geographic one). |
| `crs` | `str \| None` | `None` | CRS of the grid; points are transformed to it. The points' own CRS when omitted. |
| `origin` | `tuple[float, float]` | `(0.0, 0.0)` | ``(x, y)`` of a cell corner. |
| `extent` | `tuple[float, float, float, float] \| None` | `None` | ``(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)``: the cells expected to be present (all cells it overlaps). |
| `max_cells` | `int` | `1000000` | Largest expected grid; a larger one is not assessed. |

#### `WeightsSpec`

How zones' neighbours are found: contiguity, nearest neighbours, a band or a table.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | `Literal['queen', 'rook', 'knn', 'distance_band', 'table']` | `queen` | ``queen``/``rook`` contiguity (zone polygons, or grid cells), ``knn`` and ``distance_band`` (zone centroids or cell centres), or a ``table`` of pairs. |
| `k` | `int` | `4` | Neighbours per zone for ``knn``. |
| `distance` | `float \| None` | `None` | Band for ``distance_band``: metres for a geographic CRS, else CRS units. |
| `row_standardize` | `bool` | `True` | Divide each zone's weights by their total. |
| `table` | `Crosswalk \| None` | `None` | For ``table``: ``from``/``to`` (``weight``) pairs of zone ids, as a crosswalk is written (``{dataset: name}``, ``{path: file}`` or ``{pairs: [[a, b], ...]}``); the weights need not sum to 1. |

#### `Crosswalk`

Zone ``from`` -> zone ``to`` (with a split ``weight``), from a dataset, file or list.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | `str \| None` | `None` | A configured dataset holding the pairs. |
| `path` | `str \| None` | `None` | A local CSV or Parquet file holding the pairs. |
| `pairs` | `tuple[tuple[Any, Any] \| tuple[Any, Any, float], ...] \| None` | `None` | Inline ``[from, to]`` or ``[from, to, weight]`` pairs. |
| `from_column` | `str` | `from` | Column of the child (or old) zone ids. |
| `to_column` | `str` | `to` | Column of the parent (or new) zone ids. |
| `weight_column` | `str \| None` | `None` | Split shares of each ``from`` zone; weight 1 for every pair when omitted. |
| `tolerance` | `float` | `1e-09` | How far a ``from`` zone's weights may sum from 1. |

#### `RankCheck`

The zones rank alike: Spearman's correlation of their values reaches a minimum.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_spearman` | `float` | `0.9` | Lowest Spearman correlation of the zones' values on the two sides. |

#### `ShareCheck`

No zone's share of its side's total changes by more than ``max_change``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_change` | `float` | `0.01` | Largest change of a zone's share (0.01: one percentage point). |

#### `MoranCheck`

The per-zone differences are not spatially clustered (global Moran's I).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_i` | `float` | `0.1` | Moran's I at or above which clustering of the differences is material. |

#### `LisaCheck`

No zone sits in a significant cluster of material changes (local Moran's I).

*No parameters.*

## Measures

Entry-point group: `qavf.compare.measures`.

### `count`

Rows per group, or non-missing values of ``column`` when one is given.

*No parameters.*

### `distinct_count`

Distinct non-missing values per group.

*No parameters.*

### `max`

Largest non-missing value (any ordered type).

*No parameters.*

### `mean`

Exact mean of non-missing values.

*No parameters.*

### `median`

Exact median (linear interpolation between the middle values).

*No parameters.*

### `min`

Smallest non-missing value (any ordered type).

*No parameters.*

### `null_count`

Missing values (null or NaN) per group.

*No parameters.*

### `quantile`

Exact quantile ``p`` (NumPy's linear interpolation).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `p` | `float` | **required** | Probability, e.g. 0.9 for the 90th percentile (NumPy's linear method). |

### `share`

Each group's exact share of the side's total (of ``column``, else of rows).

*No parameters.*

### `std`

Sample standard deviation (binary64, as computed by the backend).

*No parameters.*

### `sum`

Exact sum of non-missing values; a group with none has no sum.

*No parameters.*

### `weighted_mean`

Exact weighted mean; a group with a negative weight has none.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `weight` | `str` | **required** | Weight column; rows with a missing weight are left out. |

## Comparators

Entry-point group: `qavf.compare.comparators`.

### `abs_diff`

``\|candidate - baseline\|``.

*No parameters.*

### `diff`

``candidate - baseline``.

*No parameters.*

### `log_ratio`

``ln(candidate / baseline)``; defined when both are positive.

*No parameters.*

### `ratio`

``candidate / baseline``; undefined for a zero baseline.

*No parameters.*

### `rel_diff`

``(candidate - baseline) / \|baseline\|``; undefined for a zero baseline.

*No parameters.*

### `share_change`

Change of the value's share of its side's total (``c/C - b/B``).

*No parameters.*

## Alignment steps

Entry-point group: `qavf.compare.alignment`.

### `assign_zones`

Each row's zone id from a layer, a grid or an attribute column, plus a crosswalk.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `predicate` | `Literal['intersects', 'contains']` | `intersects` | ``intersects``: boundary points belong to the zone; ``contains``: interior only. |
| `overlap` | `Literal['error', 'first', 'all']` | `error` | A point inside several zones: refuse, the lowest zone id, or every such zone. |
| `max_unassigned` | `float` | `0.0` | Largest fraction of rows without a zone; more leaves the result not assessed. |
| `column` | `str` | `zone` | The zone column added (or, with ``zones``, the column the crosswalk rewrites). |
| `x` | `str \| None` | `None` | Longitude or easting column of each row's point. |
| `y` | `str \| None` | `None` | Latitude or northing column. |
| `geometry` | `str \| None` | `None` | A WKB point column instead of ``x``/``y``. |
| `crs` | `str` | `EPSG:4326` | CRS of the points; transformed (x first) to the layer's or grid's CRS. |
| `baseline_crs` | `str \| None` | `None` | The baseline's points' CRS when it differs from ``crs``. |
| `candidate_crs` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |
| `layer` | `ZoneLayer \| None` | `None` | Zone polygons of both sides. |
| `baseline_layer` | `ZoneLayer \| None` | `None` | The baseline's zones, when the zones were re-drawn (with ``candidate_layer``). |
| `candidate_layer` | `ZoneLayer \| None` | `None` |  |
| `grid` | `Grid \| None` | `None` | Regular grid cells instead of polygons. |
| `zones` | `str \| None` | `None` | An attribute zone column already in the data (county, TAZ, link id). |
| `crosswalk` | `Crosswalk \| None` | `None` | Maps ``crosswalk_side``'s zone ids to the other side's (or both sides' zones to their parents). |
| `crosswalk_side` | `Literal['baseline', 'candidate', 'both']` | `baseline` | The side whose zones the crosswalk rewrites, or ``both`` (a hierarchy: links to zones, zones to counties). |
| `apportion` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `[]` | Columns a split zone's rows divide by the split weight (e.g. trips). |
| `weight_column` | `str \| None` | `None` | Add each row's split weight (1 when not split), e.g. for ``sum(weight)``. |
| `unmapped` | `Literal['error', 'drop']` | `error` | Rows whose zone the crosswalk lacks: refuse, or drop them (recorded). |

#### `ZoneLayer`

Zone polygons: ``{dataset: name}`` or ``{path: file}``, with an ``id`` column.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | `str \| None` | `None` | A configured dataset holding the zones (an id and a WKB or WKT geometry column). |
| `path` | `str \| None` | `None` | A local GeoParquet, GeoJSON, shapefile or other ``ST_Read`` file (relative to the configuration). |
| `id` | `str` | `zone` | Zone id column. |
| `geometry` | `str \| None` | `None` | Geometry column: ``geometry`` for datasets and GeoParquet, ``geom`` for ``ST_Read``. |
| `crs` | `str` | `EPSG:4326` | CRS of the polygons; a file declaring another one is refused. |
| `layer` | `str \| None` | `None` | Layer of a multi-layer file (``ST_Read``'s ``layer``). |
| `repair` | `bool` | `False` | Replace invalid geometries with ``ST_MakeValid`` (recorded) instead of refusing them. |

#### `Grid`

Square cells of ``size`` CRS units from ``origin``, optionally over an ``extent``.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `float` | **required** | Cell width in CRS units (metres for a projected CRS, degrees for a geographic one). |
| `crs` | `str \| None` | `None` | CRS of the grid; points are transformed to it. The points' own CRS when omitted. |
| `origin` | `tuple[float, float]` | `(0.0, 0.0)` | ``(x, y)`` of a cell corner. |
| `extent` | `tuple[float, float, float, float] \| None` | `None` | ``(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)``: the cells expected to be present (all cells it overlaps). |
| `max_cells` | `int` | `1000000` | Largest expected grid; a larger one is not assessed. |

#### `Crosswalk`

Zone ``from`` -> zone ``to`` (with a split ``weight``), from a dataset, file or list.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | `str \| None` | `None` | A configured dataset holding the pairs. |
| `path` | `str \| None` | `None` | A local CSV or Parquet file holding the pairs. |
| `pairs` | `tuple[tuple[Any, Any] \| tuple[Any, Any, float], ...] \| None` | `None` | Inline ``[from, to]`` or ``[from, to, weight]`` pairs. |
| `from_column` | `str` | `from` | Column of the child (or old) zone ids. |
| `to_column` | `str` | `to` | Column of the parent (or new) zone ids. |
| `weight_column` | `str \| None` | `None` | Split shares of each ``from`` zone; weight 1 for every pair when omitted. |
| `tolerance` | `float` | `1e-09` | How far a ``from`` zone's weights may sum from 1. |

### `cast`

Convert column types losslessly; any changed value refuses the alignment.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `dict[str, CastSpec]` | `{}` |  |

#### `CastSpec`

A lossless type conversion of one column (``{dtype: int}`` or just ``int``).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dtype` | `Literal['int', 'float', 'decimal', 'str', 'bool', 'date', 'datetime']` | **required** |  |
| `scale` | `int \| None` | `None` | Decimal places for ``dtype: decimal``. |
| `side` | `Literal['baseline', 'candidate', 'both']` | `both` | Which dataset's column is converted. |

### `columns`

Rename baseline columns to their candidate names.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `dict[str, str]` | `{}` | Baseline name -> candidate name. |

### `derive`

Compute the same new columns on both sides.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `dict[str, str]` | `{}` | New column name -> Polars SQL expression. |

### `filter`

Keep the rows in scope: a per-side condition and a shared one.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseline_where` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |
| `candidate_where` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |
| `where` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |

### `recode`

Replace categorical values through an explicit map.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `dict[str, Recode]` | `{}` |  |

#### `Recode`

Replace categorical values, e.g. codes renamed between versions.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `values` | `dict[str, Any] \| list[tuple[Any, Any]]` | **required** | ``old: new`` (mapping keys are text; they are converted to the column type) or a list of ``[old, new]`` pairs for typed old values. |
| `side` | `Literal['baseline', 'candidate', 'both']` | `baseline` |  |
| `unmapped` | `Literal['keep', 'null', 'error']` | `keep` | Values without a mapping: kept (when losslessly representable), made null, or reported (the comparison is then not assessed). |

### `shift_time`

Move one side's time column by a calendar offset (year over year, week over week).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `column` | `str` | **required** | Time column (a Date or Datetime) to shift. |
| `offset` | `CalendarOffset` | **required** | How far the candidate is ahead of the baseline, e.g. ``{years: 1}`` to compare 2025 with 2024, ``{weeks: 1}``, or ``{years: 1, same_weekday: true}`` (364 days). |
| `side` | `Literal['baseline', 'candidate']` | `candidate` | The side whose time moves: the candidate back by ``offset``, or the baseline forward by it. |
| `time_zone` | `str \| None` | `None` | Zone whose wall clock calendar offsets follow (naive times are local there); aware columns default to their own zone. |
| `unaligned` | `Literal['error', 'drop']` | `error` | Rows without an exact counterpart (29 February a year earlier, a local time a DST change skips or repeats): refuse the alignment, or drop them (counted in the alignment record). |

#### `CalendarOffset`

How far one dataset's time is ahead of the other's (``{years: 1}``).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `years` | `int` | `0` | Calendar years on the local wall clock (29 February has no counterpart). |
| `months` | `int` | `0` | Calendar months (a 31st without a counterpart is reported, never clamped). |
| `weeks` | `int` | `0` |  |
| `days` | `int` | `0` | Calendar days: the same local time of day, across DST changes. |
| `hours` | `int` | `0` | Elapsed hours of physical time (so are minutes and seconds). |
| `minutes` | `int` | `0` |  |
| `seconds` | `int` | `0` |  |
| `same_weekday` | `bool` | `False` | Count each year as 52 weeks (364 days), keeping the weekday. |

### `units`

Scale columns by an exact factor (unit or scale conversion).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `dict[str, UnitConversion]` | `{}` |  |

#### `UnitConversion`

Multiply one side's column by ``factor`` so both sides share a unit.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `factor` | `int \| Decimal \| float` | **required** | Exact for integers and decimals; a float factor means its decimal spelling. |
| `side` | `Literal['baseline', 'candidate']` | `baseline` |  |
| `from_unit` | `str \| None` | `None` | The unit the column must be declared in (``schema.columns.<c>.unit``), if declared. |
| `to_unit` | `str \| None` | `None` | The unit after conversion, compared with the other side's declared unit. |

## Statistical tests

Entry-point group: `qavf.inference.tests`.

### `anderson_darling`

Anderson-Darling k-sample test of a common distribution (tail-sensitive).

*No parameters.*

### `bootstrap`

Bootstrap of the difference of the measure's statistic (sum, median, quantile...).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |
| `resamples` | `int` | `2000` | Random resamples (more: steadier p-values, more work). |
| `interval` | `Literal['percentile', 'bca']` | `percentile` | Confidence interval of the difference (BCa costs ``n^2`` jackknife work). |

### `brown_forsythe`

Brown-Forsythe test of a difference of spread.

*No parameters.*

### `ks`

Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test of any difference of distribution.

*No parameters.*

### `mann_whitney`

Mann-Whitney U: does one side tend to have larger values?

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |

### `paired_bootstrap`

Bootstrap of the mean (or another statistic) of matched differences.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |
| `resamples` | `int` | `2000` | Random resamples (more: steadier p-values, more work). |
| `interval` | `Literal['percentile', 'bca']` | `percentile` | Confidence interval of the difference (BCa costs ``n^2`` jackknife work). |

### `paired_permutation`

Sign-flip permutation test of the mean difference of matched values.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |
| `resamples` | `int` | `2000` | Random resamples (more: steadier p-values, more work). |

### `paired_t`

Paired t-test of the mean difference of matched values.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |

### `permutation`

Permutation test of the difference of the measure's statistic.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |
| `resamples` | `int` | `2000` | Random resamples (more: steadier p-values, more work). |

### `poisson`

Exact conditional test of two Poisson rates (counts per exposure).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |

### `sign`

Exact sign test of matched values.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |

### `two_proportion`

Pooled two-proportion z-test of two shares.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |

### `welch_t`

Welch's t-test of the difference of means (from each side's moments).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |

### `wilcoxon`

Wilcoxon signed-rank test of matched values.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alternative` | `Literal['two-sided', 'less', 'greater']` | `two-sided` | ``greater``: the candidate is larger; ``less``: smaller. |
